biggest_catch: Simple terms: $100 for a new checking account with $500+ in ACH direct deposits within 90 days. Qualifying deposits must be regular electronic payments via ACH (salary, pension, Social Security) — transfers, mobile/ATM deposits, tax refunds, and wires do not qualify; the offer must be presented on opening day.
catches: Offer must be presented on the day of account opening to receive the incentive.

Qualifying Direct Deposits must be regular electronic payments (e.g., salary, pension, Social Security) made via the ACH network; transfers between accounts, mobile deposits, ATM deposits, tax refunds, and wire transfers do not qualify.
Offer not available to existing Chickasaw Community Bank customers, or those whose accounts have been closed within 90 days or closed with a negative balance within the last 3 years.
New checking account requires a $500 minimum deposit; the account must be open and have a positive balance at the time of bonus fulfillment.
Must qualify within 90 days of account opening; bonus is paid within 30 days of meeting all requirements.
Limit one promotional account per household; employees of Chickasaw Community Bank are not eligible.
Offer may be modified or terminated at any time — no fixed expiration date is published; all accounts and bonuses are subject to approval and eligibility requirements.
